subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork candidate for the Feishu reply-mention bug, or keep this issue open without queueing a new repair lane?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the only active closing-syntax implementation is a conflicting fork copy of a same-repo PR that previously needed proof and safer routing changes.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork PR only as context and land a target-repo current-main fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection, scope-aware routing, focused tests, and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Ask the fork author to refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase into openclaw/openclaw and provide inspectable redacted Feishu proof.

options.title: Defer the Feishu reply fix
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu channel bug until a Feishu-area maintainer can own the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR only as context and land a target-repo current-main fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection, scope-aware routing, focused tests, and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent merged Feishu parser, mention-type, and thread-context history near the affected current-main paths.
